onbTitle.message: Find where brokers list you · Opt-Out Ledger

onb1H1.message: Anyone can find your home address in one search.

onb1Lede.message: Data brokers collect your name, address, phone number, and relatives, then publish them on people-search sites. An ex, a scammer, a stranger with a grudge. Anyone can look you up.

onb1Pt.message: Every broker has an opt-out, but each form works differently and new sites pop up constantly. Opt-Out Ledger turns that mess into a checklist you can finish.

onb2H1.message: Twelve sites likely list you. Find every one.

onb2Lede.message: Opt-Out Ledger ships with a directory of the twelve biggest data brokers. Your first guided check takes under ten seconds after install. No account, no signup, nothing leaves your browser.

onb2Cap.description: Caption above the broker tag row.

onb3H1.message: Save the details opt-out forms keep asking for.

onb3Lede.message: Every broker form wants the same things. Your name, city, state, maybe an email or phone. Enter them once here and the extension pre-fills each form when you click Fill. You review and submit every time.

onb3Pt.message: Only first and last name are required, because the forms ask for them. Everything else is optional, and you can skip this whole step and set it up later in Settings.

onbSavedOk.message: Saved. Every opt-out form fills from this now.

onb4H1.message: Your info never leaves this device.

onb4Lede.message: The extension makes zero network calls, the code is MIT-licensed open source, and one developer stands behind it, someone you can reach.

onb4Pt.message: Opt-Out Ledger is where you meet Zovo. The bigger idea is an honest layer for the whole extension world, one tool at a time. No tracking, no data resale, no SEO spam.

onb4Trust1P.message: Profiles live in browser storage on this machine. No account, no sync server, no analytics.

onb4Trust2P.message: Not a faceless company. One developer builds in public and answers you directly at
onb4Trust2P.description: Trust row 2 text before the GitHub link.

onb4Trust3H.message: Read every line, fix what you find

onb4Trust3P.message: MIT-licensed and open. Audit the code, fork it, or build on it.

onb5H1.message: Free tracks three. Find all twelve with Pro.

onb5Lede.message: The free tier is a real tool, not a demo. One payment of ninety-nine dollars covers the whole directory and turns on every Pro feature in this extension.

onb5FreeF1.message: Guided checks and opt-out assist on all 12 brokers

onb5FreeF2.message: Track any 3 brokers in your ledger

onb5FreeF3.message: One private profile, on this device only

onb5ProF2.message: Automatic re-check reminders at your interval

onb5ProF4.message: Status dashboard with full event history

onb5Guar.message: Incogni Standard costs $$95.88 every year. Opt-Out Ledger Pro is $$99 once. Prefer monthly? It is $$4.99 on the upgrade page.
onb5Guar.description: Price-anchor guarantee line (approved anchor copy; $$ = literal $).

onb6H1.message: Find your first listing in one click.

onb6Lede.message: Click the Opt-Out Ledger icon in your toolbar, pick a broker, and run the check. The extension opens the broker's own search page. You look, then mark what you found.

onb6SignBody.message: I build Zovo on my own, in the open. If something breaks, write to me and I answer. If you go Pro, your ninety-nine dollars funds the next honest tool, and your notes shape what it becomes.

onb6Pt.message: Checks you run stay in your ledger on this device. Come back any time to mark an outcome or start the next broker.
